TestCase.name: testBatchSizeAllowsTopNPushdown
TestCase.Resource: SELECT a, vector(a, b) FROM T ORDER BY a DESC LIMIT 3
LogicalSort(sort0=[$0], dir0=[DESC-nulls-last], fetch=[3]) +- LogicalProject(a=[$0], EXPR$1=[vector($0, $1)]) +- LogicalTableScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, T]])

PythonCalc(select=[a, vector(a, b) AS EXPR$1]) +- SortLimit(orderBy=[a DESC], offset=[0], fetch=[3], strategy=[AppendFastStrategy]) +- Exchange(distribution=[single]) +- TableSourceScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, T]], fields=[a, b, c])

TestCase.name: testDifferentConcurrencySplitsCalc
TestCase.Resource: SELECT p2(a, b), p4(a, c) FROM T
LogicalProject(EXPR$0=[p2($0, $1)], EXPR$1=[p4($0, $2)]) +- LogicalTableScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, T]])
PythonCalc(select=[f0 AS EXPR$0, p4(a, c) AS EXPR$1]) +- PythonCalc(select=[a, c, p2(a, b) AS f0]) +- TableSourceScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, T]], fields=[a, b, c])

TestCase.name: testKeyedAggregationRepartitionsAfterPython
TestCase.Resource: SELECT a, SUM(v) FROM (SELECT a, p2(b, c) AS v FROM T) GROUP BY a
LogicalAggregate(group=[{0}], EXPR$1=[SUM($1)]) +- LogicalProject(a=[$0], v=[p2($1, $2)]) +- LogicalTableScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, T]])

GroupAggregate(groupBy=[a], select=[a, SUM(v) AS EXPR$1]) +- Exchange(distribution=[hash[a]]) +- PythonCalc(select=[a, p2(b, c) AS v]) +- TableSourceScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, T]], fields=[a, b, c])

TestCase.name: testNestedConcurrencyRemainsBeforeTopN
TestCase.Resource: SELECT a, plain(p2(a, b), b) + 1 FROM T ORDER BY a DESC LIMIT 3
LogicalSort(sort0=[$0], dir0=[DESC-nulls-last], fetch=[3]) +- LogicalProject(a=[$0], EXPR$1=[+(plain(p2($0, $1), $1), 1)]) +- LogicalTableScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, T]])

SortLimit(orderBy=[a DESC], offset=[0], fetch=[3], strategy=[AppendFastStrategy]) +- Exchange(distribution=[single]) +- Calc(select=[a, +(f0, 1) AS EXPR$1]) +- PythonCalc(select=[a, plain(p2(a, b), b) AS f0]) +- TableSourceScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, T]], fields=[a, b, c])

TestCase.name: testNestedDifferentConcurrencySplitsDeterministically
TestCase.Resource: SELECT p2(a, p1(a, c)) FROM T
LogicalProject(EXPR$0=[p2($0, p1($0, $2))]) +- LogicalTableScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, T]])
PythonCalc(select=[p2(a, f0) AS EXPR$0]) +- PythonCalc(select=[a, p1(a, c) AS f0]) +- TableSourceScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, T]], fields=[a, b, c])

TestCase.name: testNonDeterministicDependenciesRemainSeparate
TestCase.Resource: SELECT p1(random(a, b), b), p2(random(a, b), b) FROM T
LogicalProject(EXPR$0=[p1(random($0, $1), $1)], EXPR$1=[p2(random($0, $1), $1)]) +- LogicalTableScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, T]])

PythonCalc(select=[f0 AS EXPR$0, p2(f1, b) AS EXPR$1]) +- PythonCalc(select=[b, p1(random(a, b), b) AS f0, random(a, b) AS f1]) +- TableSourceScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, T]], fields=[a, b, c])

TestCase.name: testSameAndUnspecifiedConcurrencyStayTogether
TestCase.Resource: SELECT p2(a, b), p2(a, c), plain(a, b) FROM T
LogicalProject(EXPR$0=[p2($0, $1)], EXPR$1=[p2($0, $2)], EXPR$2=[plain($0, $1)]) +- LogicalTableScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, T]])
PythonCalc(select=[p2(a, b) AS EXPR$0, p2(a, c) AS EXPR$1, plain(a, b) AS EXPR$2]) +- TableSourceScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, T]], fields=[a, b, c])

TestCase.name: testSharedDependencyAcrossAlternatingConcurrencies
TestCase.Resource: SELECT p1(a, b), p1(p2(p1(a, b), c), b) FROM T
LogicalProject(EXPR$0=[p1($0, $1)], EXPR$1=[p1(p2(p1($0, $1), $2), $1)]) +- LogicalTableScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, T]])

PythonCalc(select=[f0 AS EXPR$0, p1(f00, b) AS EXPR$1]) +- PythonCalc(select=[f0, b, p2(f1, c) AS f00]) +- Calc(select=[f0 AS c, f1 AS b, f2 AS f0, f2 AS f1]) +- PythonCalc(select=[c AS f0, b AS f1, p1(a, b) AS f2]) +- TableSourceScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, T]], fields=[a, b, c])

TestCase.name: testUnorderedLimitAllowsPushdown
